description: This file defines the SetValue class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for DynamoDB. The class represents a DynamoDB set (SS/NS/BS) value, providing methods for serialization, counting, iteration, and conversion to array.

classes.name: SetValue
classes.description: Represents a DynamoDB set value (SS, NS, or BS) with JSON serialization, countability, and iterable features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetValue object with an array of values.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the set values as an array for PHP and JSON serialization.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of values in the set.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the set values.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Prepares the set values for JSON serialization.
